rationale: The candidate statement supports a course-scale QA deployment and reports 36ms p50 latency. Its explicit GitHub link resolves to cs3-qa-monitoring, whose integrated local backend uses Google BERT, while deepset exists in a separate qa-local repository. No version/event evidence in the accepted licensing context resolves which implementation the measured deployment used. Preserve PARTIALLY SUPPORTED for the full model/metric/deployment bundle rather than infer contradiction or merge repositories. The instrumentation requirement was correctly omitted; no timing claim is upgraded into instrumentation work.
